name: @tapra/mcp

tools.name: tapra_status
tools.description: Check the Tapra connection: API health, available models, current prices, output folder, and whether ffmpeg is installed. Free. Call this first when a tool fails.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the Tapra voices for text_to_speech and create_voiceover, with a description of each. Free. Also answers questions about voice cloning, which is not currently available.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the Tapra balance (TND), total spent, and the 10 most recent charges for this API key. Free.

tools.name: speech_to_text
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file with Tapra, which handles Tunisian Derja mixed with French and English. One call writes a folder with the transcript as txt, srt and vtt (plus a .json with full timings). Speakers are labelled by default (no extra charge): the result says how many were detected, with talk time, a quote and an audio clip of each, and a speakers.html page. When there are several speakers, ask the user whether to name them, then call name_speakers. Long files are split into chunks automatically. Costs money per minute of audio.

input_path.description: Path to the audio or video file.

formats.description: Files to write. Default: all three (txt, srt, vtt). A .json with full timings is always written too.

diarize.description: Find who speaks when (no extra charge). Set false for a single speaker.

language.description: Language hint. Usually leave unset: code-switching is auto-detected.

prompt.description: Names, brands or jargon likely to appear, to help recognition.

max_chars_per_subtitle.description: Longest subtitle line in srt/vtt, in characters.

output_dir.description: Folder to write into. Defaults to a new folder in the output folder.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Make subtitles for a video: extracts the audio, transcribes Derja/French/English, and writes srt, vtt and txt in one go, timed for reading. Speakers are labelled and colored by default (no extra charge), with a speaker report and a clip of each voice; when there are several, ask the user whether to name them, then call name_speakers. Set burn_subtitles to also render a copy of the video with the subtitles drawn in. Needs ffmpeg. Costs money per minute.

input_path.description: Path to the video file (mp4, mov, mkv, webm...).

formats.description: Files to write. Default: all three (txt, srt, vtt). A .json with full timings is always written too.

diarize.description: Label and color each speaker (no extra charge). Set false for a single speaker.

prompt.description: Names or jargon likely to appear.

burn_subtitles.description: Also render an MP4 with the subtitles drawn on the picture (speaker colors kept).

subtitle_font.description: Font for burned subtitles. Must support Arabic; Tahoma and Segoe UI do (Arial drops the لا ligature).

output_dir.description: Folder to write into. Defaults to a new folder in the output folder.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: name_speakers
tools.description: Give the speakers found by speech_to_text or transcribe_video real names (and optionally colors), then rewrite the txt, srt and vtt with those names. Each speaker keeps one subtitle color (srt <font> colors, vtt voice styles). Labels given the same name are merged into one speaker. Free, works offline. Can also burn the named subtitles into the video.

transcript_path.description: The .json from the transcript folder (or the folder itself).

names.description: Speaker label to name, e.g. {"S1": "Riadh", "S2": "Host"}. Unlisted speakers keep their label.

colors.description: Optional label or name to color: #RRGGBB or a word (amber, skyblue, green, pink, violet, yellow, teal, peach, red, orange, blue, purple, white, gold).

formats.description: Files to write. Default: all three (txt, srt, vtt). A .json with full timings is always written too.

burn_subtitles.description: Also render the source video with the named, colored subtitles drawn in.

tools.name: diarize_audio
tools.description: Find speaker turns in an audio or video file (no transcript). Returns each turn with its speaker and times. Costs money per minute.

input_path.description: Path to the audio or video file.

output_path.description: Save the turns as JSON here.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Speak text in Tunisian Derja (Arabic script or Arabizi), French, English, or a mix with one of the Tapra voices, with Tunisian pronunciation. Voices: amal = Mature woman. Warm, grounded, everyday Tunisian.; salma = Younger woman. Lighter and brighter, conversational.; salah = Man with a big, sharp (aigu) voice that carries. Strong presence. The default Tapra voice.; fahmi = Middle-aged man. Normal, natural male voice.; leo = Young man. Light and energetic.. Add non-verbal effects inline with tags (not billed): [euh] breathy hesitation; [aaa] long filler while thinking; [hmm] closed-mouth "mmm"; [ahem] clears the throat; [ouf] tired sigh; [breath] out-breath, "haah"; [stutter] repeats the first sound of the next word; put it right before that word. Example: "[euh] ma na3rafch, [breath] khalli nchouf". Saves the audio in the chosen format (wav by default, 18 other formats). Voice cloning and custom voice design are not currently available: if the user asks to clone a voice, say so and offer these voices. Costs money per character. For long scripts or narration timed to a video, use create_voiceover.

text.description: What to say. May include effect tags like [euh], [hmm], [breath].

voice.description: Tapra voice: amal = Mature woman. Warm, grounded, everyday Tunisian.; salma = Younger woman. Lighter and brighter, conversational.; salah = Man with a big, sharp (aigu) voice that carries. Strong presence. The default Tapra voice.; fahmi = Middle-aged man. Normal, natural male voice.; leo = Young man. Light and energetic.. Voice cloning is not available.

quality.description: "full" = best quality; "flash" = same voices, about 5x faster and cheaper.

convert_arabizi.description: Convert Arabizi (e.g. "3aslema") to Arabic script before speaking, as Voice Studio does.

duration_seconds.description: Force the clip to last this long.

format.description: Audio format: wav (default, lossless), mp3_<rate>_<kbps>, pcm_<rate> (16-bit WAV), ulaw_8000 / alaw_8000 (telephony), opus_48000_<kbps> (Ogg Opus). mp3, opus, ulaw and alaw need ffmpeg.

output_path.description: Where to save. Relative paths go in the output folder; the extension follows the format.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: create_voiceover
tools.description: Turn a script or a subtitle file into one narration track for video work. Each line is spoken with the same Tapra voice (amal = Mature woman. Warm, grounded, everyday Tunisian.; salma = Younger woman. Lighter and brighter, conversational.; salah = Man with a big, sharp (aigu) voice that carries. Strong presence. The default Tapra voice.; fahmi = Middle-aged man. Normal, natural male voice.; leo = Young man. Light and energetic.; voice cloning is not available) and placed on a timeline: at its subtitle time (from srt_path) or one after another (from script or lines). Lines may use effect tags ([euh] breathy hesitation; [aaa] long filler while thinking; [hmm] closed-mouth "mmm"; [ahem] clears the throat; [ouf] tired sigh; [breath] out-breath, "haah"; [stutter] repeats the first sound of the next word; put it right before that word). Writes a folder with the voiceover track (wav or another format), one WAV clip per line, and manifest.json (text + start/end per clip) that video generation tools can follow. Optionally lays the voiceover onto a video. Reports progress per line. Costs money per character.

script.description: Plain narration text. Split into lines at line breaks and long sentences.

lines.description: Narration already split into lines, spoken in order.

srt_path.description: SRT/VTT file: each subtitle is spoken at its own time (dubbing).

voice.description: Tapra voice: amal = Mature woman. Warm, grounded, everyday Tunisian.; salma = Younger woman. Lighter and brighter, conversational.; salah = Man with a big, sharp (aigu) voice that carries. Strong presence. The default Tapra voice.; fahmi = Middle-aged man. Normal, natural male voice.; leo = Young man. Light and energetic.. Voice cloning is not available.

quality.description: "full" = best quality; "flash" = same voices, about 5x faster and cheaper.

convert_arabizi.description: Convert Arabizi (e.g. "3aslema") to Arabic script before speaking, as Voice Studio does.

timing.description: With srt_path: "fit" stretches or squeezes each line to its subtitle slot; "natural" keeps natural length.

gap_seconds.description: Pause between lines when there are no timings.

format.description: Audio format: wav (default, lossless), mp3_<rate>_<kbps>, pcm_<rate> (16-bit WAV), ulaw_8000 / alaw_8000 (telephony), opus_48000_<kbps> (Ogg Opus). mp3, opus, ulaw and alaw need ffmpeg.

video_path.description: Also produce a copy of this video with the voiceover as its sound.

original_audio_volume.description: With video_path: keep the original sound under the voiceover at this volume (0 = replace it).

output_dir.description: Folder to write into. Defaults to a new folder in the output folder.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate between Tunisian Derja and English, French, or Modern Standard Arabic (in both directions). Call list_translation_languages for the exact target names. Costs money per character.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: list_translation_languages
tools.description: List the languages translate accepts as source and target. Free.

tools.name: convert_script
tools.description: Convert Tunisian text between Arabizi (Latin letters and digits, e.g. "3aslema, chna7welek?") and Arabic script, in either direction. Costs money per character.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

tools.name: play_audio
tools.description: Play an audio or video file on this computer's speakers (for example a clip you just generated). Returns right away while it plays; a new play stops the previous one. Set stop to just stop playback. Free.

input_path.description: File to play: a path in the input or output folder, or a tapra://output/... resource.

tools.name: find_in_transcript
tools.description: Find when a word or phrase is said, with timestamps, in a transcript saved by speech_to_text or transcribe_video (.json gives word-level times; .srt/.vtt give subtitle-level times). Matches Arabic script with or without harakat and letter variants (أ/ا, ة/ه, ى/ي), French accents optional, and small typos when fuzzy. Useful for cutting video ("where does he say X?"). Free, runs locally.

query.description: Word or phrase to find, in the same script as the transcript.

fuzzy.description: Also match near spellings (words of 3+ letters).

tools.name: edit_audio
tools.description: Prepare audio for videos and posts, locally with ffmpeg: join several files in order, trim, remove long silences, normalize loudness (-14 LUFS for social video, -16 podcasts, -23 broadcast), fade in/out, and convert to any of the 19 formats. Video inputs contribute their sound. Writes a new file; never changes the originals. Free.

input_paths.description: Audio or video files, joined in this order.

trim_start.description: Keep audio from this second (of the joined audio).

trim_end.description: Keep audio up to this second (of the joined audio).

silence_threshold_db.description: Quieter than this counts as silence.

channels.description: auto = mono only if every input is mono.

format.description: Audio format: wav (default, lossless), mp3_<rate>_<kbps>, pcm_<rate> (16-bit WAV), ulaw_8000 / alaw_8000 (telephony), opus_48000_<kbps> (Ogg Opus). mp3, opus, ulaw and alaw need ffmpeg.

output_path.description: Where to save. Relative paths go in the output folder.

tools.name: translate_subtitles
tools.description: Translate an SRT or VTT file between Tunisian Derja and English, French, or MSA, keeping every timing and speaker label. Lines are sent in batches to keep cost low. Pair with create_voiceover (srt_path) to dub a video. Reports progress per batch. Costs money per character.

input_path.description: SRT/VTT file, e.g. from transcribe_video, or a tapra://output/... resource.

output_path.description: Where to save. Default: <name>.<target>.srt in the output folder.

max_cost_tnd.description: Refuse to run if the estimated cost is above this many TND. Defaults to TAPRA_MAX_COST_TND when set.

instructions: Tapra speech and language tools for Tunisian Derja code-switched with French and English. Paid tools spend the user's Tapra balance (TND) and report cost and remaining balance. Input files must be inside /tmp (relative paths resolve there). Results are saved in /tmp/Tapra; existing files are never overwritten. For subtitles use transcribe_video; to dub, translate_subtitles then create_voiceover; edit_audio prepares audio; play_audio plays results; find_in_transcript finds when something is said; call tapra_status if anything fails. Voices: amal = Mature woman. Warm, grounded, everyday Tunisian.; salma = Younger woman. Lighter and brighter, conversational.; salah = Man with a big, sharp (aigu) voice that carries. Strong presence. The default Tapra voice.; fahmi = Middle-aged man. Normal, natural male voice.; leo = Young man. Light and energetic.. Voice cloning is not currently available; if asked to clone a voice, say so and offer these voices.
stderr: Tapra MCP server ready (site https://www.tapra.tn, output /tmp/Tapra).
